briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P500 +0.3%), but two candidates, BE and BB, showed all four bullish technical signals together, so we used some of the idle cash to open two new diversifying positions rather than waiting further.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: This is when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price versus moving average, and trading volume — all point the same direction at once. When they align, it gives more confidence in a trade than relying on just one signal, even if the overall market is quiet that day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指多個獨立的技術指標，例如RSI、MACD、股價與移動平均線的關係，以及成交量，同時指向同一方向。當這些訊號一致時，即使當日大市表現平淡，也能為個股交易決定提供更高信心。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted only slightly higher today, with the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the NASDAQ up 0.4%, suggesting investors were largely in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to major catalysts. Individual stock movement was more pronounced than the index-level move, with several momentum names showing coordinated volume and trend signals even as the broader market stayed quiet. No major headline-driven catalysts were identified for today's session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，標普500指數升0.3%，納斯達克指數升0.4%，反映投資者普遍處於觀望狀態，未見明顯的重大消息刺激。相比之下，個別具動能的股份表現較為突出，成交量及技術指標同步發出買入訊號，即使大市整體波動不大。今日未有發現明顯的頭條新聞驅動因素。

trades.reasoning: All four signals aligned (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, volume surge) and adds clean-energy exposure not already in the portfolio.
Full signal confirmation with a bullish RSI and volume surge gives a lower-priced, diversifying software/security position to deploy idle cash.
